verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents sparse vectors for "precise word matching" that can be fused with dense results via RRF/DBSF inside the database, so keyword-style retrieval is possible without a separate search engine. However, this works through sparse embeddings the developer must configure and generate, not a documented native full-text index. missing for 10: an evidenced native full-text/keyword index or text-match filter, BM25-style scoring docs, and hands-on corroboration of keyword search quality.
